title: Nutrients recovery from liquid anaerobic digestate by combining nanofiltration and struvite precipitation - The case of dairy effluents valorization
source_type: peer-reviewed conference paper / pilot case report
geography: Industrial dairy-processing anaerobic digestion plant; location not specified in abstract
material_scope: Liquid digestate from anaerobic digestion of dairy-processing effluents; pilot nanofiltration followed by struvite precipitation
data_handling: Transcribed discrete results stated in the publisher-hosted abstract. Approximate values and process basis are retained as reported; no values inferred from plots or chemistry.
limitations: Dairy-effluent digestate is not GreenHub grass digestate; nutrient speciation, salts, solids and organics may differ materially.
The 60% NF permeate recovery does not define membrane flux, pressure, fouling, energy or cleaning demand.
Approximate retentate concentrations are not feed concentrations and should not be treated as total N or total P.
The near-optimal N:Mg:P ratio and pH are study conditions, not universal parameter values.
The precipitate mass is not a purity or saleable-product yield; no complete nutrient/product mass balance is provided in the abstract.
